character_profiles.name: Bolt
character_profiles.build: Small, compact, slightly boxy, sturdy but not heavy, with visible metallic panels and joints
character_profiles.face_details: Two large, circular optical sensors that function as expressive eyes, capable of conveying shyness or curiosity; no mouth or nose
character_profiles.outfit: Integrated metallic chassis, primarily sleek silver with subtle blue accents around the optical sensors and joints
character_profiles.distinguishing_features: Highly expressive optical sensors, compact and slightly clunky form factor, metallic sheen
character_profiles.reference_prompt: A small, compact robot named Bolt, designed in a 3D animated, semi-stylized Pixar aesthetic with warm realistic lighting. Bolt's chassis is primarily metallic silver with subtle deep blue accents around its two large, circular, highly expressive optical sensors, which serve as its eyes. Its build is slightly boxy and sturdy, suggesting a functional, somewhat clunky nature, but its overall form is clean and appealing, reflecting a modern robot design.

character_profiles.name: Maya
character_profiles.build: Slender and athletic, with a graceful posture that hints at her dancing ability
character_profiles.face_details: Kind, almond-shaped eyes that crinkle when she smiles, a warm and encouraging expression, and high cheekbones
character_profiles.hair: Medium-length, wavy dark brown hair that flows naturally and adds to her dynamic look, often styled to allow movement
character_profiles.outfit: A vibrant, flowing top in a warm color like coral pink, paired with comfortable, stylish teal blue high-waisted pants or a skirt that allows for free movement, possibly with subtle geometric patterns
character_profiles.distinguishing_features: Energetic and warm demeanor, graceful movement, expressive eyes and smile
character_profiles.reference_prompt: Maya is a human character in her early 20s, rendered in a 3D animated, semi-stylized Pixar art style with warm realistic lighting. She has a slender, athletic build and graceful posture, with medium-length, wavy dark brown hair. Her kind, almond-shaped eyes and warm smile convey an encouraging and vibrant personality. Maya wears a flowing coral pink top paired with comfortable, stylish teal blue high-waisted pants, designed to allow her natural flair for dancing to shine through.

character_profiles.name: Party Guests
character_profiles.build: Diverse range of human body types (slender, athletic, average, slightly heavier) and a few compact, friendly-looking robots
character_profiles.face_details: Varied facial features reflecting different ethnicities, all with joyful, relaxed expressions, laughing or smiling. Robot faces are simple and friendly
character_profiles.hair: A wide variety of human hairstyles and colors (straight, curly, short, long, blonde, black, brown, red). Robots have no hair
character_profiles.outfit: Diverse, colorful, and stylish casual party wear appropriate for a rooftop gathering, including various tops, dresses, pants, and skirts, in a broad palette of colors
character_profiles.distinguishing_features: A diverse mix of joyful humans and friendly robots, all engaged in socializing and dancing, contributing to a vibrant party atmosphere
character_profiles.reference_prompt: A diverse group of party guests, including humans of varied ethnicities and body types, alongside a few friendly, simple robots, all depicted in a 3D animated, semi-stylized Pixar art style with warm realistic lighting. Humans sport a wide array of colorful, casual party outfits and diverse hairstyles, while the robots have sleek, metallic designs. All characters exude joyful, relaxed expressions, engaging in dancing and conversation, contributing to a vibrant and uplifting rooftop party atmosphere.
